title: Vegan-friendly Filipino Skirt Steak Gataang-Bilao-Bilao
description: A comforting Filipino dish featuring skirt steak, vegetables, and sticky rice, cooked in coconut milk and flavored with spices. This vegan-friendly version replaces traditional fish sauce with a plant-based alternative.

ingredients.name: fish-free sauce
ingredients.notes: such as nam pla or vegan fish sauce

instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger, and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the skirt steak and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth, tomato paste, fish-free sauce, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Add the rice and stir-fry for about 5 minutes, until the rice is well coated with the sauce.
Transfer the mixture to banana leaves or to individual serving cups, and serve with steamed vegetables.
Serve the Gataang-Bilao-Bilao with steamed sticky rice and a side of steamed vegetables.
Simmer the sauce for an additional 10-15 minutes to thicken it, if desired.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
